book.name: Lapana Yane
book.title: LAPANA YANE Kataisato Jonenga Pii Lapana Yane Oko

content: Sipisipi Andopane Okomane Ipa Wakaiya Pata Atane Yanane Oko Taka Leane Oko

Sipisipi Andopane okomane buku tongo pitane ateane okona wakaiya yanane oko taka lea-angi, ati kenga yuu epene okona pii mindi nalene, kiki-keke aŋakopi mindi nalene, mee wete ya-kola, miniti paiyasa tepopi mindi pea.
Wuane pea-kola, nambato enjole yanasa Gotena wenonga ateaini tupa andewa-kola, mindimane biakulu yanasa enjole utupane maya.

Okone angi, enjole waka mindimane ita tua tunduma peakale lo pauta yangalaini pelesa golo-mane waa-pene mindi awua epoto, kiŋi pitiyane toko okona wenosa-tole alata toko golo-mane waa-pene mindi yane ongane mandaka poto atea. Enjole okonemane ita tua tunduma peakale lo yangalaini pauta okone moto, Gotena wandakali pitaka-mane pote lalaini tupa pauta okone towa mina mindiki lea. Mina mindiki loto, Gote lo opa mindi alata okonena maiyakale nembo toto, mindimane ita tua tunduma peakale lo yangalaini pauta kambua minditupa enjole okone maya.
Balato opa okone maya-angi, enjole okonena kininga tua tunduma-pene ateane okopi, Gotena wandakali tupamane pote lalaini tupapi, utupane Gote peteanga pea.

Pea-kola, enjole okonemane alata toko okona ita lengane yane tupa moto, tua tunduma peakale loto pauta yangalaini pelesa okone mo tumbi laya wato, yuunga ainena lea. Yuunga ainena lea-kola, yuu tapale puato, ati kulu lalu, yuu yundukumi minu dii-dee lalu, pea.
Wuane pea-kola, enjole yanasa tupamane biakulu auwa ateaini utupane biakulu peyoyale makande peai.

Makande peai-kola, enjole bulupane okomane balana biakulu oko pelea. Pelea-kola, Goteto kingi apanepi, ita kaiyapianepi, tundupapi, utupane mina mindiki loto, yuunga ainena lea. Yuunga ainena lea-kola, Goteto yuupi, itapi, utupane pitaka wamba tombo peyoto, tale pua tepo peane utupanena yomo mindina tani kaka-enepi, itapi, utupane pitaka ita-mane tokoyo pea.

Tokoyo pea-kola, enjole lapone okomane balana biakulu oko pelea. Pelea-kola, Goteto yuu wangiane andane wetete ita too atene gulene mindi ipa solewata tombenenga auwa tepa ya. Tepa ya-kola, Goteto ipa solewata wamba tombo peyoto, tepo peane utupanena tepone oko tundupa gulea.

Ipa solewata okone tundupa gulea-kola, minditaka saka atene Goteto ipa solewata pangosa yakale leane utupane tale pua tepo peane utupanena yomo mindi oma yiake leai. Dee, Goteto sipi tupa tale pua tepo pea-kola, sipi utupanena yomo mindi koya yiake leai.

Sipi utupane koya yiake leai-kola, enjole tepone okomane balana biakulu oko pelea. Pelea-kola, ita lungu tapata mindimane talane wuane pua teke, kaiyanda andane ita lungu tapeta mindi yuu okona tepa ya. Kaiyanda okonena gene oko matasini kaa-pene lalaini. Kaiyanda okonemane yuu Goteto tombo tepo peleane tupana tombo mindina ipa lai yungalane tupapi, ipa epo pene tupapi, utupanena tepa wato, utupane mo kaa piya ya-kola, wandakali kambua-mane ipa kaa-pene utupane noto omeai.

Omeai-kola, enjole tukuni okomane balana biakulu oko pelea. Pelea-kola, Goteto nai oko tale puato, tepo gulaya yane okonena tepone oko mo undupi laya ya. Wuane pea-kola, otonga awa tukumindipi mindi nai lene oko taa napea-kola, undupi lamangua ya. Wuane pua teke, Goteto ana okopi, kaiyanda tupapi, utupane tale pua tombo tepo puato, utupanena tombo mindi mo undupi laya ya. Undupi latane atea-kola, awa tukumindipi mindi ana okopi, kaiyanda tupapi, utupane taa napea-kola, undupi lamangua ya.

Okone angi nambato andewa-kola, eka aiyawe andane mindi ati kenga yuu lo awua epea. Nambato ale ewa-kola, eka okonemane pii taimane wete loto, enjole tepo mee maliyo ateyai tupamane yakamana biakulu peyolai-angi, kenda-pene andane wete minditupa yuu pitakana wandakali tupanga epola-kola, utupane ondo wetete ape-pene atolopeyai lea.
